title: Herbicide
description: Clear grass, plants, and trees instantly with a simple spray
body:
Tired of overgrown grass, unruly flowers, or dense forests getting in the way of your builds?
  Herbicide adds two simple-but-powerful spray items that let you clear vegetation instantly — with a quick fan-shaped sweep for normal use, or a massive circular blast when charged up.

  ────────![orginal](https://cdn.modrinth![herbicide](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2741d04d3d2142ac92bc082a9bae4dfc41e47df6_0.webp).com/data/cached_images/6b222aade0bc7a9144f4087cc4909d1784be829c_0.webp)───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
![potent herbicide](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/15e57701a5b6bdd50fa78dcac72ce2df425922c3_0.webp)  Features

  • Two tiers of cleanup
    • Herbicide — clears grass, ferns, dead bushes, seagrass, and kelp.
    • Potent Herbicide — clears almost any plant, including flowers, leaves, logs, crops, vines, mushrooms, bamboo, lily pads, bee nests, coral, and more.
  • Smart fan-shaped spray (normal use)
    Right-click to spray a 120° fan-shaped area in the direction you are facing.
    This clears only what is in front of you, so your farms and buildings behind you stay safe.
    • Herbicide: up to 16 blocks ahead, ±8 vertical.
    • Potent Herbicide: up to 20 blocks ahead, ±32 vertical.
  • Massive charged cleanse (hold right-click for 1 second)
    Release a circular blast that radiates outward in 8 concentric rings (radius 96, height ±64). The rings expand with a slight delay to keep server load smooth. Great for flattening large fields or clearing jungles in one go.
  • No item drops — destroyed plants vanish completely, keeping your inventory clean.
  • Particles & sound effects — satisfying green dust spray for the normal herbicide, and fiery orange-red dust for the potent version.

  ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Recipes

  • Herbicide
    Iron Ingot + Water Bucket + Glass Bottle (vertical)
  • Potent Herbicide
    Gold Ingot + Lava Bucket + Glass Bottle (vertical)

  ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Supported Versions

  • Minecraft 1.21.1 — NeoForge
  • Minecraft 1.20.1 — Forge
